newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Palace sources say Suharto in good health.
newsitem.headline: Palace sources say Suharto in good health.

text.p: Palace sources said late on Thursday Indonesia's President Suharto was at home and in good health after a normal day's activities, despite renewed rumours on foreign exchange markets that he was ill.
"These rumours are crazy. The president is at home and in good health," one source told Reuters.
The Indonesian rupiah weakened to 2,407/12 in London trading at 1055 GMT. Banking sources attributed the decline from a Jakarta close of 2,403.25/04.00 to the rumours on Suharto's health.

But one U.S. bank dealer in Jakarta said London operators seemed to be trying to move up the dollar rate because they had suffered heavy losses after the rupiah plunged against the dollar on similar health rumours on Wednesday.
"I think they are trying to raise it (the dollar) to be able to sell it later," he said.
The rupiah fell to 2,420 in London and New York on Wednesday before settling around 2,405 after sources close to the presidency in Jakarta had denied Suharto was ill.
